verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents building single-click apps for its marketplace and lists official developer tooling: API clients, the Checkout SDK, an open-source design system for apps that feel native in the control panel, and app-level OAuth credentials. The evidence does not show app scaffolding tooling or a documented app review/approval process, and the marketplace distribution path is only stated in a single line. Missing for 10: scaffolding/starter tooling for apps, a documented app review and submission process, in-depth marketplace distribution docs, independent hands-on corroboration of the app-building workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom apps and extensions with official SDKs, scaffolding tooling, and a documented review/distribution path
